Brick Breaker

One narrow entrance. A whole field to break.

Gray tiles stay. Colored tiles break. Yellow and red caps open the channel exits. Catch the falling boosts to grow your swarm.

Play: drag anywhere on the board. Watch: AUTO controls the paddle using the same physics. Use 1× / 2× / 4× to change simulation speed.

Keyboard: ← → or A/D · Space launch/continue · P/Escape pause.
